object.name: evi.crossover.allpass~
object.digest: Allpass filter for aligning audio bands using evieve crossover filters
object.description: Multiband Linkwitz-Riley crossover filters require alpass alignment. This filter gives access to the same filters used in all the evieve crossover filters, in case a custom summing method is wished for.
object.discussion: Of course <o>evi.crossover.allpass~</o> is also just a very useful allpass filter away from this crossover business :-)

inlets.description: This should be fed from the 'High Frequency Cutoff' of a multiband crossover filter split to achieve correct alignment.

attributes.name: order
attributes.description: 0=1-pole allpass filter, 1=2-pole allpass filter. 1-pole allpass filters are for aligning one band of a 2-pole crossover filter. 2-pole allpass filters are for aligning one band of a 4-pole crossover filter.
